## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The `preview` containment check needs fixing before merge because it compares paths without resolving them, so a request like `"../secret.txt"` reads files outside the home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview` and `settings_file` helpers to `app/paths.py` and adds tests for them in `tests/test_paths.py`. It also adds a one-line text file, `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` passes the check and reads `home/../secret.txt`, which is outside home. `is_relative_to` only compares path segments without resolving them, so `Path(home) / "../secret.txt"` still starts with `home` and the `..` is never resolved; a symlink inside home is also followed. — Any caller that passes a user-chosen relative path can read any file the process can access, limited to its first 200 characters. — Fix: Call `.resolve()` on both `candidate` and `Path(home)` before `is_relative_to`, and add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
